owner: PROJECT_BACKLOG.md V3 P3→P4 economic experiment; same existing 10:15 Work/milestone route
user_preference: Technical failure modes must be isolated, measured and fail-closed; in experimental Paper, deliberate strategic risk-taking can be wider within unchanged execution safety.
question: Does permitting an otherwise completely confirmed early CONTINUITY setup with legitimate 5m volume ratio 1.0–<1.2 enable additional actually tradeable, positive net Paper outcomes versus the frozen >=1.2 Standard policy?
rationale: Two V3-B 5-case trials produced no Full Assessment and V2R4 1864 candidates no BUY; volume confirmation may be too strict for otherwise healthy entry structure, but V2R4 24h paths show downside. This is a falsifiable single-rule paper-only hypothesis; not a conclusion that volume caused the historical 0 BUY.

arms.decision_logic: Unmodified V3 P3 early CONTINUITY review: all closed 15m base/reclaim, fresh 5m continuation, min volume ratio >=1.2, spread, anti-chase, live Spot EUR PIT, structural stop reference; separate real Full-Model BUY needed.

Same candidate, timestamp, same PIT/candles/ticker/full entry model contract. Only after all seven other Standard hard checks PASS, permit review eligibility with independently VALID closed 5m volume ratio 1.0 <= volume <1.2; neither force BUY nor lower any other safety limit.

prospective_measurement_once_separately_.sampling: Pre-registered bounded recent independent real original CONTINUITY candidates at common observation timestamp; not selected by subsequent 24h MFE
prospective_measurement_once_separately_.compare: Paired same candidate and clock Standard vs Experimental; experimental produces at most one extra full-evaluator research request if permission and budget separately granted. Never count mock outputs.
prospective_measurement_once_separately_.approval_and_budget: Separate explicit named approval for max cases, max model HTTP incl retries, observation window and cost. No approval from this code/PR.
record: At-time input completeness and technical errors
Separate observed review eligibility for each arm
